(莽草 (mǎngcǎo) is its envoy; 半夏 (bànxià), 栝蔞 (guālóu), 貝母 (bèimǔ), 白蘞 (báiliǎn), and 白芨 (báijí) [are its envoys]; it fears 藜蘆 (lílú).)

The original text of the 《Bencao Jing》: 烏頭 (wūtóu), flavor acrid, warm. It governs wind-stroke and evil wind (中風惡風), washing and sweating (洗洗出汗), removes cold-damp bi (寒濕痹), cough...
